Eduardo Mondlane was the founder and first president of FRELIMO, the Mozambique Liberation Front, and is honoured as the architect of Mozambican independence.

Born in a Tsonga village in the south, he studied in South Africa, Portugal and the United States, where he earned a doctorate and worked for the United Nations. In 1962 in Dar es Salaam he united exile groups into FRELIMO and in 1964 launched the war of independence.

He was killed by a parcel bomb in Dar es Salaam in February 1969, probably with the help of Portuguese agents and rivals in his movement. Samora Machel took over the leadership. The university of Maputo bears his name.
sum: Eduardo Mondlane was the founder and first president of FRELIMO, the Mozambique Liberation Front, and is honoured as the architect of Mozambican independence.
